prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: a production-quality full-screen portrait Android Chinese chess game UI design reference for the cute Chinese app 叽里咕噜.
Input image 1 is a reference ONLY for chess-piece lettering, board grid and the little purple sprout-cloud mascot identity. Completely replace its layout. The user rejects the large boxed player information panels and generic rounded cards.

Primary request: design a tasteful, calm, compact, warm Japanese game interface with NO big information boxes or player cards. It must look deliberately designed like a good mobile board game, with tangible wooden pieces, quiet ivory paper, restrained lavender ink, soft chestnut brown. Elegant practical hierarchy, coherent line icon set. Flat screenshot, straight on, no phone mockup or poster.

Layout:
- A slim top bar with back arrow on the left and modest title “阿噜棋桌”. In this SAME top area, one tiny clock icon plus red turn dot and ONE countdown “01:42” on the right. Only one shared turn countdown; no separate player timers anywhere.
- A small unboxed row below: “和阿噜下” with a tiny down chevron; right small text “红方回合”. No oversized controls or pill containers.
- The main Xiangqi board fills most available width with small margins. Ivory honey-colored wood, slim dark brown 9-file/10-rank lattice with river gap and palace diagonals, readable 3D wooden disks with authentic red/black Chinese chess characters. Rounded board corners very subtle. The board is the hero. Demonstrate one red piece selected with a thin lavender rim and legal destination shown with a small green point. Correct Chinese chess arrangement preferred.
- Beneath the board, four standalone small matching line icon buttons with short captions: “暂停”, “重开”, “残局”, “规则”. They have no enclosing card, no large background rectangle, no huge capsules.
- One quiet small hint line, “每手两分钟，慢慢想也没关系”. A tiny purple sprout-cloud mascot peeking into one lower corner may add personality without taking space.
- A couple of tiny paper fibers and one delicate lavender doodle near an outer edge; enough character to feel cute, very little decoration.

Text exact and restrained. Render well aligned, comfortable tap targets and dense enough to be useful. Avoid giant typography, high saturation, thick colored outlines, dashboards, form fields, giant empty gaps between content, avatars in panels, split clocks, layered generic cards, grids of mode buttons, neon/gloss plastic, heavy shadows, English labels and watermarks. Native implementation should be feasible in Compose/Canvas; all interactive elements visually separate and understandable. Portrait roughly 9:20 aspect ratio.
implementation: Native Compose and Canvas rebuild the layout and interactive board; generated bitmap is a design reference only.
